title: Dealer Retail Agreements Performance Standards: Watch, Suspension and Reinstatement
content:
An active dealer under the Dealer Retail Agreements is placed on watch when its trailing first-payment default rate reaches the tier's watch rate or its title-delinquent contracts reach the tier's watch count; a dealer on watch is reviewed after 60 calendar days and cleared when both measures are below the watch thresholds, otherwise suspended.

## Standards

**S1. Watch.** An active dealer is placed on watch when its trailing first-payment default rate reaches the watch first-payment default rate of its tier, or its title-delinquent contracts reach the watch title-delinquent count of its tier.

**S2. Watch review.** A dealer on watch is reviewed after 60 calendar days and cleared when both measures are below the watch thresholds, otherwise suspended.

**S3. Suspension.** A dealer is suspended at once on any of the suspension triggers, including title-delinquent contracts reaching the suspension title-delinquent count of its tier; a suspended dealer receives no new fundings. The suspension triggers, for every tier, are: dealer license lapsed; surety bond cancelled; confirmed dealer fraud; title delinquency over the threshold; unpaid chargeback invoice over 60 days.

**S4. Reinstatement.** A suspended dealer is reinstated only when every item of the reinstatement requirements is met — trigger cured; outstanding chargebacks paid; titles delivered below the watch count — reviewed within 30 calendar days.

**S5. Servicing and dealer contact.** Watch and suspension never affect servicing of contracts already funded. The dealer support line answers dealers Monday-Friday 8:00-19:00, Saturday 9:00-17:00 (Central time). A borrower complaint forwarded to a dealer must be answered within 5 business days.

## Thresholds by tier

| Dealer Program tier | Watch: first-payment default rate (percent) | Watch: title-delinquent contracts | Suspension: title-delinquent contracts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dealer Program Bronze | 9.0 | 3 | 6 |
| Dealer Program Silver | 8.0 | 3 | 6 |
| Dealer Program Gold | 7.0 | 4 | 8 |
| Dealer Program Platinum | 6.0 | 4 | 8 |
| Dealer Program Diamond | 5.5 | 5 | 10 |
| Dealer Program Elite | 5.0 | 5 | 10 |

## The measures

- **Trailing first-payment default rate.** Of the agreement's contracts funded in the 90 calendar days ending 60 days before the review date, the percent whose first installment was not paid within the first-payment default period of its due date.
- **Title-delinquent contracts.** At the current date, the agreement's funded contracts with no title received whose contract date plus the title delivery deadline is earlier than the current date.

## Status movements

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| Active | On watch | Performance or title delinquency crosses a watch threshold |
| On watch | Active | The watch review finds the thresholds met again |
| Active | Suspended | A suspension trigger occurs; new contracts are not funded |
| On watch | Suspended | A suspension trigger occurs, or the watch review finds the thresholds still missed |
| Suspended | Active | Every reinstatement requirement is met and funding resumes |

The move from suspended back to active is an agent action; the other movements in this table are system transitions.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Dealer Program Gold agreement)

| Facts | Result |
|---|---|
| Active; first-payment default rate 7.0 percent | Reaches 7.0: placed on watch |
| Active; first-payment default rate 6.9 percent; 3 title-delinquent contracts | Neither watch threshold reached |
| Active; 4 title-delinquent contracts | Reaches 4: placed on watch |
| Active or on watch; 8 title-delinquent contracts | Reaches 8: suspended at once |
| On watch, at the 60-day review: rate 6.2 percent and 2 title-delinquent contracts | Both below the watch thresholds: cleared |
| On watch, at the 60-day review: rate 6.2 percent and 4 title-delinquent contracts | Not both below: suspended |
| Suspended; trigger cured and outstanding chargebacks paid, but 5 title-delinquent contracts | Titles not below the watch count of 4: not reinstated |
